summary: Android now reads voice RTT from both LiveKit publisher and subscriber peer connections. This fixed the reproduced blank ping on Pixel 7 when the local microphone was disabled; the room badge and persistent dock showed 92–103 ms.

checks.name: Voice connection RTT selection regression tests
checks.observation: All 8 tests passed, including subscriber ICE-pair RTT, cross-connection audio RTT priority, and retaining a previous value when a connected stats sample has no RTT.

checks.name: Full Flutter test suite and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub && flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 262 tests passed and analyzer reported no issues.

checks.name: LiveKit package tests and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop/packages/livekit_client && flutter test --no-pub test/track/local_audio_rtt_test.dart && flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: Both package tests passed and analyzer reported no issues. Stats retrieval isolates a failed peer connection so the other connection remains usable.

checks.name: Pixel 7 voice RTT acceptance
checks.observation: Installed Android 1.0.8+12, joined SHARE_TEST with the microphone disabled, and observed a live 92–103 ms ping in both the connected-room badge and persistent dock. The room had only the local participant, so this verifies the active ICE path to the server but not a second participant's media path.

checks.name: GitVerse Android release publication
checks.observation: Local release build is ready; tag-triggered workflow and downloadable release assets have not yet been confirmed.

checks.name: Second-participant and deafen acceptance
checks.observation: No second participant was present. A deafen-toggle attempt did not complete reliably, so behavior with deafen enabled remains unverified.

remaining: Publish android-v1.0.8 on GitVerse; verify RTT with a second participant and deafen enabled, then validate native/browser RTT behavior on macOS, Windows, and web.
